lines.text: GXO ran 45 humanoid robot pilots.
Its CEO says zero go into production this year.
So why do companies still rent them?
Two reasons. The second one surprises people.
One. Buying locks your cash up front.
It sits in a machine that loses value.
Rent instead, and you pay monthly.
And you avoid long commitments.
Two. The robot you buy is old when the next model ships.
Agility unveiled Digit 5 in September 2026.
Own a Digit 4, and you own the old model.
GXO's new sites start with Digit 4, then switch to Digit 5.
Since June 2024, rented Digit robots have worked in Georgia.
They moved over 100,000 totes.
GXO announced two more sites, in North Carolina and Tennessee.
They start in early 2027.
But GXO has not yet seen a return from humanoids.
Its CEO puts production about two years away.
So renting is not a bet on robots.
It is a test.
Would you rent, or buy?
